name: Magtheridon
shortDescription: Magtheridon, represented in the Akama and Black Temple research story.
body: Original interpretation of the pit lord displaced at the Black Temple in the preceding campaign. This is original AI-generated artwork for the story theater, not licensed game art, canonical model evidence, an exact costume claim or proof of co-presence. See the research and visual asset ledgers. The Champion of the Naaru story reuses this interpretive figure only for A’dal’s later quest target; it does not retell Magtheridon’s earlier defeat by Illidan.
